caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden chest of drawers, also known as a highboy, rendered in realistic detail with a brown polished wood texture. The chest stands on four curved cabriole legs and features a lower section with three drawers, the central one having a carved shell motif. The upper section contains six drawers, with the topmost row consisting of two small drawers flanking a central compartment that also has a carved shell motif. All drawers are fitted with brass handles in pairs and escutcheons. The top of the highboy is adorned with a broken arch pediment with three finials—one in the center and one at each end, with the two outermost finials featuring spiral designs. The background is a plain off-white or cream color, with no other objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Highboy
